stats.fact: FLUX.1 is a 12 billion parameter rectified flow transformer capable of generating high-quality images from text descriptions
FLUX 1.1 Pro holds the highest ranking on Artificial Analysis benchmark, outperforming Midjourney 6.1, Ideogram v2, and other platforms in visual fidelity and prompt accuracy
Flux.1-Schnell achieves 5,243 images per dollar on SaladCloud with response times as low as 2.86 seconds per image
Flux.1-Dev achieves 992 images per dollar with a 99.78% success rate and average response times under 18 seconds at 1024x1024 resolution
FLUX 2 model series was announced November 25, 2025, consisting of Pro, Flex, Dev, and Apache 2.0-licensed Klein models
FLUX.1 Kontext (released May 2025) enables instruction-based in-context image editing; Dev version is ~2x cheaper than Kontext Pro and ~3.5x cheaper than Max
Hosted API pricing for FLUX.1: fal.ai charges $0.025/image for FLUX.1 dev and $0.04/image for Flux Kontext Pro; aggregators range $0.008-$0.04/image
MLPerf Training v5.1 introduced FLUX.1 as an official benchmark with 11.9B parameters, validating it as an industry-standard model
FLUX.1 supports image resolutions up to 2K and excels in anatomy, lighting, and style adherence versus predecessors
Black Forest Labs was founded by the original creators of Stable Diffusion, including Robin Rombach and Andreas Blattmann
